text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.pu: Hides the pumpkin overlay when you equip a carved pumpkin.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.fr: Hides the freezing overlay when you start freezing after touching powder snow.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.to: Hides the totem overlay when your totem is used
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.el: Hides the elder guardian overlay when you receive the mining fatigue effect from an elder guardian.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.na: Hides the nausea overlay when you have the nausea effect.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.fi: Hides the fire overlay when you're on fire.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.sp: Hides the spyglass overlay when you zoom in with a spyglass.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.po: Hides the portal overlay when you step into a nether portal.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.un: Hides the vignette overlay when underwater. Best used in conjunction with the hide vignette option.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.da: Hides the pulsing vignette overlay when you have the darkness effect.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.option.vi: Hides the vignette overlay when in a dark environment.
text.autoconfig.nomoreoverlays.title: No More Overlays Config
